events.title: ZoomInfo (GTM): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q4 Earnings?
events.body: Shareholders of ZoomInfo would probably like to forget the past six months even happened. The stock dropped 46.4% and now trades at $6.32. This might have investors contemplating their next move.
